urdu: نروان بدھا کا مجسمہ کس میوزیم میں موجود ہے؟
english: In which museum is the Nirvana Buddha statue located?
roman_1: Nirvana Buddha ka mujasma kis museum mein mojood hai?
roman_2: Nirvana Buddha ka mojassama kis museum main mojood hay?
roman_3: Nirvana Buddha ka mojasma kis museum may mojood he?
